text: Panasonic Holdings Corporation's largest shareholders (FY2025 table, data as of 31 March 2026, republished from the EDINET annual securities report) are The Master Trust Bank of Japan (trust account, 15.06%), Custody Bank of Japan (trust account, 7.53%), State Street trusts and insurance companies; the only government name in the top 10 is 'GOVERNMENT OF NORWAY' with 1.32%. No state or sovereign shareholder is shown controlling the company.
short: Panasonic Holdings' top holders are trust banks and institutions; GOVERNMENT OF NORWAY holds 1.32%.
